Compares each outcome's price now with its price a while ago: the change in cents and in percent, for spotting markets on the move.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.priceChange` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Compare with (`window`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | How long ago, e.g. 1h or 24h. |
| Outcomes (`outcomes`) | text | no | `first` | first: the first outcome of each market, usually Yes. all: every outcome. One of `first`, `all`. |
